questions.question_english: Which type of card allows a user to spend funds up to a pre-approved credit line extended by the issuing bank, rather than deducting money directly from a savings or current account?
questions.explanation_english: A credit card provides holders with access to a revolving credit facility granted by the issuing financial institution up to a pre-approved financial limit. Unlike a debit card, which immediately deducts funds directly from the cardholder’s linked deposit account, a credit card enables purchases or cash advances on credit, requiring repayment at a later date under set terms.

questions.question_english: Which component of a debit card contains encrypted data that provides enhanced protection against cloning compared to traditional magnetic stripe cards?
questions.explanation_english: The integrated EMV microchip on modern debit cards provides enhanced defense against unauthorized card cloning and counterfeiting compared to magnetic stripe cards. The microchip generates dynamic cryptographic codes unique to each transaction, ensuring that intercepted transaction data cannot be reused to create duplicate cards or execute fraudulent transactions, thereby maintaining high standards of payment card security.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आधुनिक डेबिट कार्ड पर एकीकृत ईएमवी माइक्रोचिप अवैध कार्ड क्लोनिंग और जालसाजी के खिलाफ बेहतर सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है। यह माइक्रोचिप प्रत्येक लेनदेन के लिए अद्वितीय गतिशील क्रिप्टोग्राफिक कोड उत्पन्न करती है, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि अवैध रूप से प्राप्त लेनदेन डेटा को डुप्लिकेट कार्ड बनाने या धोखाधड़ी लेनदेन करने के लिए पुन: उपयोग नहीं किया जा सकता है, जिससे भुगतान कार्ड सुरक्षा के उच्च मानकों को बनाए रखा जा सके।
key_facts: EMV microchips enhance card security against cloning.
Dynamic cryptographic codes are generated for each transaction.
Printed answer key: (C) EMV Microchip
Modern debit cards use advanced security features.

A regulatory fee automatically billed to consumers who exceed standard daily online payment frequencies.
A recurring operational fee paid directly to third-party payment gateway vendors for network upkeep.

questions.explanation_english: A chargeback is a formal transaction reversal mechanism in electronic payment systems where disputed card transaction funds are returned to the payment cardholder. questions.explanation_english: The introduction of retail payment systems in India followed a specific timeline.
